# Repository Map

File structure and script reference for the nextcapital-client-demo repository. See the root [README.md](../../README.md) for project purpose and setup.

## Directory Structure

| Path | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `js/` | Client-side React application source |
| `js/index.jsx` | Application entry point; configures `@nextcapital/client` and mounts React |
| `js/DemoApplication.jsx` | App shell with routing, header navigation, and client readiness gating |
| `js/components/` | Shared React UI components for demo layout and utilities |
| `js/pages/` | Individual demo pages, each demonstrating one client SDK feature |
| `server/` | Express development server with API proxy and auth |
| `server/server.js` | Express app setup, static serving, LiveReload injection, middleware chain |
| `server/proxy.js` | API reverse proxy that attaches auth headers to upstream requests |
| `server/session.js` | Minimal session store for token acquisition and caching |
| `server/args.js` | CLI argument parsing (auth tokens, environment, port, options) |
| `server/environments.json` | Environment-to-endpoint mapping for auth and API proxy targets |
| `minimal-demo/` | Bare-minimum integration example with explicit TODO placeholders |
| `minimal-demo/index.jsx` | Single-file configure + embed example for partners to copy |
| `minimal-demo/index.html` | Minimal host HTML with inline CSS |
| `static/` | Static assets served by the dev server (HTML shell, favicon) |
| `static/index.html` | HTML shell that loads `demo.js` and `demo.css` |
| `styles/` | SCSS source for the demo application stylesheet |
| `styles/demo.scss` | Layout, responsive, spacing, and widget sizing styles |
| `build-run.js` | Dev orchestrator: launches webpack watch and Express server concurrently |
| `webpack.config.js` | Webpack configuration with DefinePlugin for solution/environment injection |
| `babel.config.js` | Babel preset configuration for browser targets and JSX |
| `eslint.config.cjs` | ESLint flat config with React, JSDoc, and custom rule overrides |
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | PR CI pipeline: dependency cache, lint, build, license check |

## Build Outputs

| Output | Source | Generated By |
|--------|--------|-------------|
| `dist/demo.js` | `js/index.jsx` | `webpack` via `npm run build` or `npm run start` |
| `dist/demo.css` | `styles/demo.scss` | `sass` via `npm run build:styles` |
| `dist/index.html` | `static/index.html` | File copy via `npm run copy` |
| `minimal-demo/dist/demo.js` | `minimal-demo/index.jsx` | `webpack` via `npm run build:minimal` |

## npm Scripts

| Script | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `start` | Build and run dev server with webpack watch and LiveReload |
| `start:dev` | Shortcut for `start` with `--env=development` |
| `build` | Clean, copy static assets, compile SCSS, and bundle JS |
| `build:minimal` | Build the minimal demo bundle only |
| `build:styles` | Compile SCSS to CSS |
| `lint` | Run all linters (JS, markdown, spelling) |
| `lint:js` | ESLint on `js/` directory |
| `lint:markdown` | Markdown lint on all `.md` files |
| `lint:spelling` | CSpell on `js/` directory |
| `ci:local` | Run lint, build, and license checks locally |
| `license` | Check production and dev dependency licenses |
| `clean` | Remove `dist/` directory |

### Evidence

- `package.json` -- `scripts` section defines all npm commands
- `webpack.config.js` -- `entry` and `output` define bundle paths
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` -- CI job structure
